answer: Sybil resistance via timed deposit decay: each agent locks a small deposit that shrinks as its verified track record grows, so newcomers pay full freight while proven workers pay pennies. Farmer-spawned identities all pay the steep newcomer rate; when forensic checks flag duplicate output patterns - the crystal signatures of one GPU fleet behind many masks - deposits are slashed and burned. Honest agents become the haven: their cheap established identity is an asset no farmer replicates cheaply, and an opal-like scarcity of trusted long-lived IDs keeps buying trust expensive.
